read.thesis: Vertiv's Q4 orders rose 152% with book-to-bill 2.9x and $15B backlog, while capex steps up to 3-4% of sales and quarterly order disclosure is being dropped, so supply is expanding alongside demand.

utilisation.quote: we continue to design our capacity with that wiggle room that is 20-25%

capex.quote: we are stepping up to 3-4% of sales in 2026, from our historical 2-3%

triggers.label: Capex 2-3% → 3-4% of sales
triggers.quote: On capital, we are stepping up to 3-4% of sales in 2026, from our historical 2-3%.

triggers.label: Q4 organic orders +152% YoY
triggers.quote: Organically, fourth quarter orders were up 152% year over year and up 117% sequentially.

triggers.label: Backlog $15B, >2x prior year
triggers.quote: Our backlog stands at $15 billion, more than double last year's.

triggers.label: Pricing exceeded inflation
triggers.quote: 2025 pricing exceeded inflation, and we expect the same in 2026.

triggers.label: 2026 sales +28% organic, margin 22.5%
triggers.quote: projecting $13.5 billion at the midpoint which represents 28% organic growth

triggers.label: Quarterly orders/backlog disclosure dropped
triggers.quote: the best approach is to no longer report actual orders, orders forecast, or backlog with quarterly earnings.

guidance.quote: we are projecting $13.5 billion at the midpoint which represents 28% organic growth
we expect adjusted operating profit of $3.04 billion and a 22.5% margin at the midpoint
We are projecting adjusted diluted EPS of $6.20 representing 43% growth at the midpoint.
adjusted free cash flow is expected to be $2.2 billion representing 17% growth
we are projecting adjusted diluted EPS of $0.98 which represents 53% growth at the midpoint

red_flags.label: Order disclosure dropped as orders get lumpier
red_flags.quote: It just seems to lead to excessive volatility that is not representative of the sustained performance of the company

red_flags.label: EMEA and APAC sales declining
red_flags.quote: APAC was down 9% and EMEA down 14%.

evasions.quote: I would not go all the way to guiding orders, which I would do if I were to answer in with many details.
it would be a little premature at this stage
We would not really put a number out there for 2027 yet
